A lovely addition to your fairy garden - this mod adds several retextures for the stepping stone path and the hardwood fence! They includes tons of little mushrooms in fun colors as well as a magical stepping stone set with stars, moons hearts and more. 

Requires Alternative Textures - I recommend using the spray can for a random effect, but feel free to mix and match color schemes however you wish to create the perfect magical vibe for your farm!

The mod folder includes two subfolders - if you only want the fence OR the path, simply remove the folder you dont want to use.
